crossRefs.note: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.
Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in…
What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone…
then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in…
